mode: Built-in image_gen; generated, then edited background
common:
Create a production sprite sheet, square image with EXACT 4 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS of equal square cells, 16 sprites. Absolutely NO text, titles, grid lines, outlines of cells, cast shadows, background objects, energy balls, light beams or VFX. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Do not paint a checkerboard. All subjects confined inside their own cells with 8% clear gutters. Preserve the reference armor design exactly. Crisp 2D illustrated dark navy segmented armor with narrow neon seams. Each ROW is one skill with four progressive poses left to right, not four unrelated designs. Row order: CHARGE, WAVE, ABSORB, GUARD. Constant viewpoint, same scale and stable anchors between frames. These will be cropped mechanically at exactly quarter width and quarter height.
Row1 CHARGE: frame1 default ready guard; frame2 curl hands into fists and lower elbows; frame3 retract elbows and close fists beside waist; frame4 tense peak, elbows back, fists beside torso. No open-palmed ball.
Row2 WAVE: frame1 default ready guard; frame2 rotate and gather both cupped hands beside one hip; frame3 push both hands halfway forward; frame4 both open palms thrust forward together, wrists close, fingers open, martial arts Kamehameha gesture. NO drawn beam, runtime adds it.
Row3 ABSORB: frame1 default ready; frame2 open and round elbows; frame3 raise one palm above and lower other below; frame4 Tai Chi holding-ball peak, upper palm faces down, lower palm faces up, rounded arms enclosing EMPTY small circular space. NO scoop down to abdomen, no ball.
Row4 GUARD: frame1 default ready; frame2 close fists and start raising; frame3 raise forearms in front of chest; frame4 two closed fists at cheek/brow height with two VERTICAL PARALLEL forearms, small viewing gap, not an X and not open palms.
opponent: Subject: entire purple opponent from the reference, complete connected body head to boots in EVERY CELL. Preserve purple spiky helmet, purple eyes and purple armor seams. Facing the camera from a slight fighting three-quarter stance. Feet planted on same baseline at 91% cell height, pelvis centered at same horizontal center; same head size and adult proportions. Never crop feet or helmet. No player arms.
hands: Subject: ONLY PLAYER FIRST-PERSON PAIR OF HANDS AND FOREARMS in every cell, left hand on left and right hand on right, TWO hands per cell, dark cyan-blue illuminated gloves exactly matching references. No enemy, face or body. Viewed through player's own eyes, NOT hands seen from another person. Forearms enter from bottom left/right of each cell and fade out softly before edges, to allow layering. Natural anatomically correct thumb directions, five fingers per hand. Pair spans about 80% cell width, wrists nearer bottom, tips nearer center/top. First column of every row identical default open-handed fighting stance. WAVE peak shows BACKS of hands to viewer, palms facing away, hands pushed toward forward center with empty space between them. ABSORB peak shows one hand above other below, empty space between palms. Maintain big readable shapes.
backgroundEdit: Edit target: attached sprite sheet. Change ONLY the background: remove the painted white/gray checkerboard COMPLETELY. Replace it with perfectly solid pure black RGB(0,0,0), including the holes between arms/legs/fingers. Preserve exact 4x4 grid layout, dimensions, all 16 poses, character positions, colors and armor details. No painted checkerboard, no white haze on edges. Keep neon edges narrow and sharp. This is a black-key sprite atlas for game compositing.
handsEditSuffix: Forearm ends must fade into pure BLACK, not white.
